scope: Undo only cross-page shared media metadata drift caused during page272 diagnosis; final page272 parity must not depend on these shared alt values.
one_call_combined_read: db query "SELECT 'page272' AS item, CONCAT('bytes=',LENGTH(meta_value),';sha256=',SHA2(meta_value,256),';json=',JSON_VALID(meta_value)) AS value FROM {prefix}postmeta WHERE post_id=272 AND meta_key='_elementor_data' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('media:',post_id) AS item, meta_value AS value FROM {prefix}postmeta WHERE meta_key='_wp_attachment_image_alt' AND post_id IN (104,105,106,107,108,109,110,111,112,203,204,205,206,207,208,209,210,211,212,213,214,215,216,217,218,219) ORDER BY item" --limit=100
remote_sequence: Call list_sites once for the exact rolling counter. Do not start unless enough headroom exists above D11 reserve and the latest state does not show an active conflicting job.
Run the combined read once. Abort immediately on 429, page272 hash mismatch, JSON invalidity or any unexpected drift outside 110/111.
If media 110 still differs, update only media 110 alt through /wp/v2/media/110 to the recorded prepackage value.
If media 111 still differs, update only media 111 alt through /wp/v2/media/111 to the recorded prepackage value.
Run the same combined read once. Require exact page272 hash plus exact 26/26 media map. After PASS, no further shared-media write is allowed for Hedge.

call_budget.reason: Recent HTTP 429 operations used built-in exponential retries and consumed calls faster than one nominal operation; do not start this package with only the nominal five calls above reserve.

after_pass: Proceed later to a separate page272-only EAEL gallery item-array patch setting eael_fg_gallery_img.id=0 for all 28 items while preserving URL/name/order/repeater ids and resolution=full.
do_not: Do not change media 137/138; they were outside the cross-page drift set.
Do not write any of the 26 shared media values to source-specific Hedge names after recovery.
Do not restore page272 revision wholesale.
Do not combine this recovery with the later page272 Elementor-data patch unless the expanded package has its own complete preflight/readback budget.
